paragraphs.en: Anthropic is a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC), a designation that requires us to balance the financial interests of shareholders with the benefit to the broader public. Our Public Benefit Report takes stock of what we are doing to serve the public benefit, and of the work ahead.
paragraphs.zh: Anthropic 是一家公益公司（PBC），这一 designation 要求我们在股东的经济利益与更广泛公众的利益之间取得平衡。 我们的公益报告审视了我们在服务公共利益方面正在做的工作，以及未来尚待完成的工作。

paragraphs.en: AI research and products that put safety at the frontier. AI will have a vast impact on the world. Anthropic is a public benefit corporation dedicated to securing its benefits and mitigating its risks.
